designs.artworkPrompt: Give me an image with a tide pool in watercolor style with a gloss finish and no effect. Use a background that is visually related to the tide pool. No borders, no frames. The tide pool should be horizontally and vertically centered. The subject should fill around 2/4 of the total image size. The image must use a 1:1 aspect ratio in webp format and named OCN-TPL-GEN002-0007.webp
